Escape to Oliver's & Oliver's Too, a luxurious Inlet Beach retreat with two homes for 16 guests. This unique property features a private heated pool and is just 100 yards from the beach. Enjoy ample space, professional decor, and a short stroll to Rosemary Beach's upscale dining and shops. Perfect for large families or groups seeking a coastal getaway with privacy and style. Includes 4 bikes and parking for 5 cars.
Guests will have full and private access to the entire property, including both homes, the private pool, and all listed amenities. Check-in is simple and virtual, allowing you to start your vacation without delay.

* Full Access: Entire property, including both the main and guest houses.
* Private Pool: Exclusive use of the pool and outdoor lounge area.
* Check-in: 4:00 PM
* Check-out: 10:00 AM

We prioritize your privacy and comfort. Our team will not be on the property during your stay, so you can relax and enjoy your vacation without interruption. We offer a seamless virtual check-in process. Should you need any assistance, we are readily available and responsive via the guest portal or by phone.

Inlet Beach – A Hidden Gem on 30A

Nestled on the eastern edge of Scenic Highway 30A, Inlet Beach is a charming coastal community known for its pristine white-sand beaches, laid-back atmosphere, and close proximity to Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach. This neighborhood seamlessly blends old Florida charm with modern luxury, making it a sought-after destination for travelers seeking both relaxation and adventure.

What Makes Inlet Beach Special?
Uncrowded Beaches – With one of the largest public beach accesses in the area, you’ll find plenty of space to stretch out and enjoy the Gulf’s turquoise waters.
Outdoor Adventures – Explore the nearby Camp Helen State Park, paddle along Lake Powell, or bike the scenic trails leading to Rosemary Beach and beyond.
Boutique Shopping & Dining – Enjoy local favorites like The Donut Hole, Amici 30A, and Cuvee 30A, or take a short stroll to The Shops of 30Avenue for upscale boutiques and eateries.
Secluded Yet Central – While offering a private and peaceful retreat, Inlet Beach is just minutes from the lively energy of 30A’s most iconic beach towns.

Whether you’re looking to unwind by the beach, explore nature, or experience the best of 30A’s coastal lifestyle, Inlet Beach is the perfect place to call home during your stay.

* Guest Confirmation: After booking, you will receive a link to our Guest Portal to confirm your reservation details, provide contact information, and agree to our terms. This must be completed within 72 hours of booking.
* Pool Heating: The private pool can be heated for an additional fee of $65/day plus tax. Please let us know in advance if you would like to add this service to your stay.
* Starter Supplies: We provide a starter kit of essentials, including paper towels, dish soap, dishwasher pods, laundry pods, toilet paper, and hand soap. All bed linens, bath linens, and beach towels are also provided. Guests are responsible for any additional supplies needed during their stay.
* Area Construction: Please be aware that construction is active throughout the Panama City Beach and 30A areas. We cannot be held responsible for construction noise or other related disturbances.
* Cancellation Policy: Our cancellation policy will be strictly enforced. No refunds will be issued outside of the stated policy.

House Rules
No Smoking inside the condo or on the balconies
No Pets
No parties or events without prior approval
Check-in time: 4:00 PM | Check-out time: 10:00 AM
Age Requirement: The booking guest must be 25 or older
Quiet hours are observed from 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM
Treat this home with care & enjoy your time in paradise!

Directions to Coast Is Clear
Address: 392 Walton Rose Lane, Inlet Beach, FL

Coast Is Clear is conveniently located in Inlet Beach, just steps from Rosemary Beach and minutes from all the best attractions along Scenic Highway 30A.

Driving Directions:

From Northwest Florida Beaches International Airport (ECP) (approx. 30 minutes):
Exit the airport and turn right onto SR-388. Continue for 3.7 Miles
Turn left onto US-79 S and continue for 6.6 Miles
Turn right onto US-98 W and continue for 7.9 Miles
From US 98, turn left onto S Orange St
Take the 2nd right onto Pompano St, continue to the stop sign (0.3 mi)
Turn right onto S Wall St, continue for 0.1 mi
Turn left onto Walton Rose Lane, and continue to the stop sign.
The house will be on the right on the corner of Walton Rose Lane and Winston Lane. There are 3 parking spots: 1 on Walton Rose Lane that fits 2 cars, and 2 in front of the house and guest house on Winston Lane.


From Destin-Fort Walton Beach Airport (VPS) – Approx. 1.5 hrs
Take FL-85 N and W John Sims Pkwy to FL-20 E/E Hwy 20 in Niceville
Continue on E Hwy 20 for about 58 miles.
Turn right onto US-331 and follow this 9.8 Miles south to US-98
Turn left onto US-98 and continue for 13.1 miles
Turn right onto S Orange St, continue for 308 ft
Turn right onto Walton Rose Lane, and continue to the stop sign.
The house will be on the right on the corner of Walton Rose Lane and Winston Lane. There are 3 parking spots: 1 on Walton Rose Lane that fits 2 cars, and 2 in front of the house and guest house on Winston Lane.
